notes: the holdout is revealed exactly once, after the single candidate is frozen
rationale: 70/30 chronological, the same split fraction as the ETF study, so the holdout size is inherited rather than chosen for this search. 30% of a 3,280-day window is 2.69 years, which clears the gate's 12-month minimum and leaves 6.3 years for selection and walk-forward. DECLARED ASYMMETRY: crypto cycles run about four years, so no split of nine years gives a full cycle on both sides. This split leaves the 2022 bear market in the selection window and gives the holdout the 2024-2025 upswing, which flatters long-only strategies; the holdout's own benchmark drawdown is reported so a reader can size the discount. DECLARED POWER LIMIT: the standard error of an annualized Sharpe over 2.69 years is about 0.75, so this holdout cannot separate a true Sharpe of 1.0 from zero. The verdict is a range and will be reported as one.
